description: This file defines a Prometheus metrics linter in Go, including the Linter struct, validation methods, and logic for processing metrics data.

classes.name: Linter
classes.description: A Prometheus metrics linter that checks metric names, types, and metadata for issues.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Linter that reads metrics from an io.Reader in Prometheus text format.

methods.name: NewWithMetricFamilies
methods.description: Creates a new Linter with a predefined list of MetricFamily protobuf messages.

methods.name: AddCustomValidations
methods.description: Adds custom validation functions to the linter.

methods.name: Lint
methods.description: Performs linting on the metrics data, returning problems found.

methods.name: lint
methods.description: Internal method that lints a single MetricFamily.
